com.elo.device.peripherals

Interface Printer


  • public interface Printer
    This interface provides methods by which an application can interact with the Printer present in an Elo View device

      • setLanguage

        void setLanguage(Language language)
          throws UnsupportedPeripheralMethodException
        Set the Language of the text to be followed on the printer. This is not supported on all platforms. On unsupported platforms it will throw UnsupportedPeripheralMethodException
        Parameters:
        language - language to use. A list of available languages is defined by Language
        Throws:
        UnsupportedPeripheralMethodException

      • setChineseMode

        void setChineseMode(boolean enable)
             throws UnsupportedPeripheralMethodException
        Set the printer to Chinese mode. This will be only on supported platforms. On unsupported platforms it will throw UnsupportedPeripheralMethodException
        Parameters:
        enable - true to set Chinese mode, false to clear it
        Throws:
        UnsupportedPeripheralMethodException

      • hasPaper

        boolean hasPaper()
          throws java.io.IOException

        true if there is paper, false if not

      • setBaudRate

        void setBaudRate(int baudrate)
        Sets the baud rate for the printer. This call has no effect if the printer is not serial. The programmer is responsible for using this call correctly, and ensuring that the baud rate value is a valid baud rate. Note that if the printer's baud rate is different from the host device's baud rate, it may be difficult to correct and establish connectivity. It is not recommended to use this feature.
        Parameters:
        baudrate - new baud rate for the printer

      • setPrinterPath

        void setPrinterPath(java.lang.String path)
        Sets the device path for the printer. The programmer is responsible for using this call correctly, and ensuring that the path is a valid device.
        Parameters:
        path - Linux-style device name
